from: 1. Open the line's actions and look at Decline.
to: 1. On the work order's Lines tab, open the line's three-dot menu and look at Decline.
1. On the work order's Lines tab, tick the row checkboxes to select one or more lines.

from: 1. Select the mixed set and run Approve.
to: 1. On the work order's Lines tab, tick the row checkboxes to select the mixed set, then run Approve from the bulk bar.

from: 1. Open the receive modal as this user.
to: 1. On the work order's Lines tab, click Receive on the part row to open the receive modal as this user.

from: 1. Open the wizard on a run with outstanding tech stories, picks, cores, receives and missing details.
to: 1. From the work order header three-dot menu, click Create invoice to open the completion wizard on a run with outstanding tech stories, picks, cores, receives and missing details.

from: 1. Look for a step whose work is not required.
to: 1. In the completion wizard (opened from the Create invoice item in the work order header three-dot menu), look for a step whose work is not required.

from: 1. Look for Request part on a completed line.
to: 1. On the work order's Lines tab, open the part row three-dot menu on a completed line and look for Request part.

from: 1. Select several lines, then press Deselect all.
to: 1. On the work order's Lines tab, tick the row checkboxes to select several lines, then press Deselect all in the bulk bar.

from: 1. Find the Received later permission in the Work Orders section.
to: 1. On the Roles & Permissions edit page, find the Received later permission toggle in the Work Orders section.

from: 1. For each action, sign in as a role that carries its atom and one that does not, and check whether the action is offered.
to: 1. On the Roles & Permissions edit page, read each action's permission toggle; then for each action, sign in as a role that carries its atom and one that does not, and check whether the action is offered.

from: 1. As a user without See Financial Data, open a receive surface and check money fields.
to: 1. As a user without See Financial Data, open the receive dialog on the work order's Lines tab and check money fields.

from: 1. Open the purchase order / bulk receive page.
to: 1. From the top menu open Parts, then open the Purchase Orders list / bulk receive page (provisional route - the PO pages are not yet on the QA build).

from: 1. As a View-only user, try to receive.
to: 1. From the top menu open Parts, then the Purchase Orders list page (provisional route - not yet on the QA build); as a View-only user, try to receive.

from: 1. Select several purchase orders and read the bar.
to: 1. From the top menu open Parts, then the Purchase Orders list page (provisional route - not yet on the QA build); select several purchase order rows and read the bulk bar.
